description: DAB Band III transmitters (NL + Flanders/Brussels) with TII codes, for rfscan.tdoa_dab. tii_main 0..69 / tii_sub 0..23 (EN 300 401 14.8). offset_us = known static SFN transmit-delay offset (positive = transmits later), null when unknown. Built 2026-10-30, see docs/notes-dab-tii.md.

sources.name: antenneregister.nl (RDI) WFS
sources.notes: Official Dutch antenna register. 1678 TDAB antenna records joined to 2083 broadcast sites; RD New coordinates converted to WGS84 with the RD->WGS84 polynomial approximation (~1 m). Gives frequency/block, antenna height above ground (HOOGTE) and per-antenna power (ZENDVERMOGEN dBW). No TII. Primary coordinate source for NL.

sources.name: radio-tv-nederland.nl
sources.notes: Per-site tables: street address, ERP kW, polarisation, NAP height, TII "main sub". Site links contain Google Street View positions (used only to match sites to antenneregister). States data partly from RDI/fmlist/local broadcasters. Primary NL TII source.

sources.name: fmtvdx.eu MyMaps DAB+ Landelijk
sources.notes: TII + ERP tables for NL national and regional (layer 4) ensembles. Some entries look like copy errors (e.g. MTVNL Loon op Zand 13/14 duplicating Hoogersmilde).

sources.name: fmtvdx.eu DAB+ Nederland (DX log)
sources.notes: Observed TII from DX reception in Friesland; -/- means not observed. Used as cross-check.

sources.name: fmtvdx.eu MyMaps DAB+ Lokale Radio
sources.notes: Local layer-6 TII; parsed table, site/TII alignment occasionally ambiguous. Cross-check only.

sources.name: fmtvdx.eu DAB+ Belgie
sources.notes: TII + ERP for Belgian ensembles (page dated 02-07-2025). Primary BE TII source.

sources.name: wohnort.org Netherlands
sources.notes: Ensemble IDs (EId) and labels, partial TII tables (Staumelder / radio-tv-nederland / observations, 2021-2026).

sources.name: wohnort.org Belgium
sources.notes: EIds and partial TII for VRT 12A, regional Flemish and Walloon/Brussels ensembles.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap (Overpass)
sources.notes: Named broadcast masts in Belgium (Egem, Sint-Pieters-Leeuw, Genk, Oostvleteren, Veltem, Luchtbal).

sources.name: Wikipedia List of tallest structures in Belgium
sources.notes: Coordinates of Schoten, Egem, Genk, Sint-Pieters-Leeuw, Wavre, Mechelen, Finance Tower.

sources.name: Nominatim (OSM geocoder)
sources.notes: Town centroids only, used as LOW-confidence fallback for Belgian sites without known mast coordinates.

conventions.tii: tii_main 0..69 / tii_sub 0..23 decimal as given in sources; null when not found
conventions.height_m: NL: antenneregister HOOGTE (antenna height above ground, m) for the same block where matched; BE: null
conventions.erp_kw: ERP from radio-tv-nederland / fmtvdx (licence values, kW)
conventions.confidence: high = TII confirmed by >=2 independent lists and coordinates from register/landmark; medium = single source or minor issue; low = conflict, doubtful TII, or town-centroid coordinates
